projects.name: Civic Engagement Platform
projects.description: Built core features for a multi-tenant platform serving UK local councils: committee management, public meeting scheduling with conflict detection, agenda and minutes publishing, restricted member portals, and municipal-year views across elections, petitions, consultations, and spending.

projects.name: Council Branding & Content System
projects.description: Created a configurable branding system for council sites, including hero variants, color tokens, navigation, footers, and template controls, plus a centralized MetaKeys registry for per-council content settings without code changes.

projects.name: Publishing & Public Consultation Tools
projects.description: Built a branded PDF engine for agenda packs and hard-copy bundles, with cover pages and clickable navigation, alongside consultation-response moderation with inline review and respondent-type tracking.

projects.name: Website Migration & SEO
projects.description: Helped migrate company websites from React to Next.js and implemented SEO improvements. The work cut load time by 20%, increased organic visibility by 20%, and contributed to a 5% lift in traffic and revenue.

projects.name: HR & Financial Intelligence Products
projects.description: Contributed frontend interfaces to a microservices-based HR management application and a generative AI product for financial management and fraud detection.

projects.name: Healthtracka App
projects.description: Contributed to the live React Native patient app and shipped Patient Dashboard V2 with biomarker scales, scan summaries, overdue-test alerts, dependent switching, and an interactive results timeline. The updated experience reduced patient confusion calls by 62%.

projects.name: Lab Results & Self-Service PDFs
projects.description: Built a lab-results PDF engine and self-serve download flow, turning lab data into branded reports. It passed 8,000 downloads, moved 82% of users to self-service, reduced nurse follow-up calls by 40%, and freed about 18 staff hours each week.

projects.name: Caretracka App
projects.description: Contributed to the live React Native mobile app for test booking and vitals tracking, including work across the app and its supporting API.

projects.name: Banking on Women’s Health
projects.description: Delivered a full-stack conference platform with registration, QR ticketing, and an admin check-in portal. It handled 1,200+ registrations in 48 hours, enabled 3-second check-ins, shortened queues by 72%, and reduced admin workload by 40%.

projects.name: Organization Partner Portal
projects.description: Launched a partner portal with bulk-purchase flows, increasing partner sales volume by 30% in its first quarter.

projects.name: Coutvel Website Migration
projects.description: Migrated and rehosted Coutvel’s website from WordPress to React. The site presents its security, fire-safety, solar-power, and IT procurement services to business customers.

projects.name: Academic Website
projects.description: Built a public-facing academic website for Dr. Ikenna P. Okpaleke, bringing together his theology research, publications, teaching, conferences, and professional profile.

projects.name: Invoice Generator
projects.description: A privacy-first invoice and quotation generator for creating professional documents without an account. Choose from 17+ templates and download finished invoices as PDFs.
